```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
# Count unique named storms per year by storm type and plot stacked area chart
storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year by Type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
flights_jfk <- flights |>
  filter(origin == "JFK") |>
  select(dep_delay, arr_delay, carrier)
```

```{r}
flights_jfk |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dep_delay, y = arr_delay, color = carrier)) +
  geom_point()
```
